# `aitbc zk circuits`

List available zero-knowledge circuits and their verification status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc zk circuits [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc zk circuits
```
